proposition: Qāżīzāda Rūmī studied with Ibn Turka in Samarkand under his brother Ṣadr al-Dīn, is counted a member of his circle, is reported to have been Akhlāṭī's disciple in Cairo, and about 829/1426 thanked Ibn Turka in a letter for a copy of his Sharḥ al-Basmala.

mediation.who: letter of Qāżīzāda Rūmī in the Munshaʾāt-i Turka
Gāzurgāhī; Khwāndamīr, for the Akhlāṭī discipleship
